sentences.text: Hmph. Before we discuss spectral activity, we must look at the data; the humidity in the teenager's room was elevated between 01:10 and 03:10.
Specifically, the observed humidity of 46.6 % exceeded the expected 43.8 % and was outside the expected range of 42.2 % to 44.6 %.
Given that the sensor noted 'breath on the glass', it is probably just a mundane explanation that someone was present in the room and breathing heavily.
